title: Ethiopian Potato Alicha
community: All of Ethiopia — the mild potato stew
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Potato Alicha — potatoes and onion cooked with turmeric, ginger, and garlic in a mild golden sauce without berbere. The filling, mild potato stew of Ethiopian fasting meals — turmeric-golden and fragrant with ginger.
longDesc: Potato Alicha is the fasting-period filling staple — the potatoes absorb the turmeric and ginger and become deeply flavourful, providing sustained energy and fullness during long fasting days.
steps: Heat oil. Cook onion until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, and pepper. Stir 1 minute.
Some should have partially dissolved — natural thickening.
chefTips: The potatoes that dissolve thicken the sauce naturally.
No berbere — the turmeric colour and flavour is the point.
cookingScience: See ETH105 for potato dissolution science.
sustainabilityTips: Potatoes grow abundantly in Ethiopian highlands.
healthBenefits: Potassium and vitamin C from potatoes.
culturalNote: Potato Alicha is fasting sustenance — the filling, energising stew that keeps the Orthodox faithful strong through the 200+ days of abstinence from meat and dairy.
